name: STRAY GIRL
source:
A techie finds a broken android and brings her back to life. As they rebuild her memories through training, secrets unfold, and tough choices arise. Will you fight for her freedom or let the system reclaim her? Sexy rewards await your decisions.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3626750/STRAY_GIRL/]Steam[/url]]
